description: A signed attestation that the principal performed an act on a document. The signature is detached ed25519 over docHash. The principal's identity is a DID; the verifying key is resolved via did:key embedding or a hosted did:web document.

signer.description: The principal's DID. Must match the verifying key the signature checks against.

act.description: What the principal is recording. MVP only ships `attest`; the others are reserved.

docHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical body of the stamped document, formatted as `sha256:<hex>`. Canonicalization rules: strip leading BOM, normalize CRLF→LF, strip trailing whitespace; leading whitespace inside the body is preserved.

docFilename.description: Optional advisory filename at stamp-time. The hash is authoritative; this is for human reference only.

signature.description: Detached ed25519 signature over the raw bytes of docHash. Format: `ed25519:<base64>` with 64 raw bytes.
